---
name: Feature request / 功能建议
about: Propose a feature or behavior improvement / 提议新功能或行为改进
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

## Use case / 使用场景

Describe the situation in which you need this capability.

请说明你在什么场景下需要这个能力。

## Desired solution / 期望方案

Describe the ideal workflow, UI behavior, or API behavior.

请描述理想的使用方式、页面行为或 API 行为。

## Acceptable alternatives / 可接受的替代方案

Include simpler approaches that would also address the use case.

如果有更简单的实现方式，也可以写在这里。

## Additional context / 额外信息

You may include screenshots, API sketches, relevant redacted logs, or examples from other projects.

可以附上截图、接口草案、经脱敏的相关日志或其他项目中的参考行为。
